newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Sugar's $60-mln Vietnam venture starts.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Sugar's $60-mln Vietnam venture starts.

text.p: Taiwan Sugar said on Wednesday that a US$60 million joint venture sugar plant in Vietnam has begun operations.
The sugar plant, which started production on Tuesday, has a daily crushing capacity of 6,000 tonnes of sugarcane, a company statement said.
Taiwan Sugar is the lead investor in the venture with a 40 percent stake, officials of the state firm said.
Taiwan firms King Car Food Industrial Co and I-Mei Foods Co each hold 17.5 percent stakes while Vietnam's state-run First Sugar Company owns the remaining 25 percent, they said.
The joint venture was formed in 1993.
